evals.prompt: Set up Better Auth with Google login for my Next.js app using Drizzle ORM
evals.expectedBehavior: Should ask for confirmation, read better-auth-guide.md and oauth-social-login.md, create auth config, database schema, middleware, and login UI components

evals.prompt: I need authentication for my app. I'm not sure which provider to use.
evals.expectedBehavior: Should detect no auth and present decision framework. For Next.js projects: offer Better Auth and Firebase Auth. For Vite + React Router projects: offer Clerk and Supabase Auth. Ask clarifying questions about framework before presenting provider options.

evals.prompt: Add Clerk auth with GitHub and Google OAuth to my existing Next.js project
evals.expectedBehavior: Should inform user that Clerk is not supported for Next.js projects in this plugin and suggest Better Auth or Firebase Auth. For Vite + React Router projects, Clerk IS supported — should detect if user's project is Next.js vs Vite and respond accordingly.

evals.prompt: Set up Firebase Auth for my app that needs to support both web and mobile (KMP)
evals.expectedBehavior: Should recommend Firebase Auth (best KMP support), read firebase-auth-guide.md, set up client + admin SDK, session cookies with httpOnly, and warn about PRIVATE_KEY newline issue

evals.prompt: I'm already using Supabase for my database. Add auth with email/password and Google login
evals.expectedBehavior: Should inform user that Supabase Auth is supported for Vite + React Router projects. If user's project is Next.js, explain the wizard targets Next.js with Better Auth/Firebase; Supabase Auth requires using @supabase/ssr directly. If project is Vite, proceed with 12-supabase-react-guide.md.

evals.prompt: Set up the simplest possible auth for a prototype app
evals.expectedBehavior: Should suggest Better Auth as the recommended option (self-hosted, zero cost, simple setup). Should NOT suggest Auth.js as it is not currently supported.

evals.prompt: What auth pitfalls should I watch out for before deploying to production?
evals.expectedBehavior: Should read 09-common-pitfalls.md, present relevant pitfalls organized by category (session, OAuth, database, Next.js, security, Better Auth-specific), not trigger full setup flow

evals.prompt: Set up Better Auth with email verification and complete password reset flow for my Next.js app
evals.expectedBehavior: Should read better-auth-guide.md, create auth config with requireEmailVerification: true and sendVerificationEmail/sendResetPassword handlers, create all UI components including reset-password.tsx, set up middleware using cookie-based pattern (NOT auth() wrapper — that's Auth.js, see pitfall #43), and document the full forgot → email → reset → login flow

evals.prompt: I need production-ready Better Auth with rate limiting and security headers for my SaaS app
evals.expectedBehavior: Should read better-auth-guide.md, configure rateLimit (10 req/60s), session management (expiresIn, updateAge, cookieCache), reference next.config.ts security headers template, explain that Better Auth handles CSRF internally, and create the file creation checklist

evals.prompt: My Better Auth forgot-password email sends a link but users get a 404 error when they click it
evals.expectedBehavior: Should identify that reset-password.tsx is missing, provide the component from assets, explain that requestPasswordReset({ redirectTo }) sends users to /reset-password which needs a page, and guide through creating the route at app/(auth)/reset-password/page.tsx

evals.prompt: Set up Firebase Auth for my Next.js app with Google OAuth. I want all the UI components and middleware.
evals.expectedBehavior: Should copy components from assets/components/firebase/ (NOT from root assets/components/), copy middleware from assets/middleware/firebase/nextjs-middleware.ts, and copy shared components (globals.css, dashboard-page.tsx) from assets/components/shared/. Should NOT mix Better Auth and Firebase components.

evals.prompt: I have an existing Next.js project with Tailwind and custom colors (blue-600 primary). I want to add Better Auth without changing my existing design.
evals.expectedBehavior: Should detect existing Tailwind setup (Scenario B), read globals.css and tailwind.config.ts, identify custom colors, merge shadcn/ui CSS variables into existing globals.css mapping blue-600 to --primary, install tailwindcss-animate if missing, then proceed with Better Auth setup. Should NOT overwrite existing globals.css.

evals.prompt: Add Firebase Auth to my project that already uses shadcn/ui with the New York style
evals.expectedBehavior: Should detect shadcn/ui via components.json (Scenario A), SKIP globals.css generation, note the New York style, and proceed directly with Firebase Auth setup using existing theme. Should reference 10-existing-project-integration.md.

evals.prompt: Set up Firebase Auth and generate a complete README explaining how to configure the Firebase project
evals.expectedBehavior: Should run Step 8 — copy assets/templates/providers/firebase/README.md.tmpl, substitute {{PROJECT_NAME}}/{{NEXT_VERSION}}/{{PROVIDER}}, process <!-- IF oauth=google --> blocks based on user's Step 1a answer, write to project root README.md. Output must include Firebase Console link, deep-link to references/05-firebase-auth-guide.md OAuth checklist, full env vars table with 'Where to get it' column. Must NOT improvise content from memory.

evals.prompt: Set up Better Auth with Drizzle, Resend email, and Google OAuth — also generate the README
evals.expectedBehavior: Should run Step 8 — copy better-auth/README.md.tmpl, keep <!-- IF oauth=google --> and <!-- IF email=resend --> blocks (delete other email branches), document BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (with openssl rand -hex 32 example), RESEND_API_KEY, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET in env table with source links. Verify no raw {{ placeholders or <!-- IF markers remain.

evals.prompt: Run /shipwithai-auth:setup in a project that already has a README.md with my own content
evals.expectedBehavior: Step 0 detects existing README.md; before Step 8 generates anything, MUST call AskUserQuestion offering: append AUTH section, overwrite with README.md.bak backup, or save separately as README.AUTH.md. Must NOT silently overwrite the user's existing README.

evals.prompt: Just install the Better Auth packages and config files, don't generate any documentation
evals.expectedBehavior: Should set up auth.ts, auth-client.ts, schema, middleware, etc., but skip Step 8 (README generation) since user explicitly opted out. Step 2m guard should respect the opt-out and not force README creation. Should mention that user can run setup again later for full README.

evals.prompt: Add password reset flow to my existing Better Auth project — don't change anything else
evals.expectedBehavior: Should ONLY add reset-password.tsx and update auth client; should NOT regenerate README, should NOT run full Step 0 wizard, should NOT touch existing auth.ts beyond what's needed for password reset. README generation Step 8 must NOT trigger.

evals.prompt: Set up auth for my Vite React app with React Router v6
evals.expectedBehavior: Should detect Vite framework (vite.config.*) and React Router v6 (react-router-dom in deps). Should offer Clerk or Supabase Auth as options (NOT Better Auth or Firebase for the React SPA wizard). Should present the React-specific provider decision framework.

evals.prompt: Add Clerk authentication to my React Router app
evals.expectedBehavior: Should detect Vite + React Router, read 11-clerk-vite-react-guide.md, install @clerk/react-router-js (NOT @clerk/nextjs), wrap the app with <ClerkProvider routerType='path'>, create sign-in and sign-up routes with <SignIn> and <SignUp> pre-built components, and copy clerk/ component assets.

evals.prompt: I have a Vite project — add login and signup pages with Google OAuth
evals.expectedBehavior: Should detect Vite framework, check for React Router in deps. If React Router present, proceed to Step 1 React path (Clerk or Supabase). Should ask which provider. Should NOT assume Next.js. Should NOT use any Next.js-specific patterns (no next/navigation, no useRouter from next).

evals.prompt: Set up Supabase Auth for my React SPA with Google OAuth
evals.expectedBehavior: Should read 12-supabase-react-guide.md, install @supabase/supabase-js (NOT @supabase/ssr — that's for Next.js), create AuthContext with onAuthStateChange, create ProtectedRoute, create LoginPage with signInWithOAuth('google'), add /auth/callback route with AuthCallback component, and walk through Google OAuth setup in Supabase Dashboard.

evals.prompt: Add auth to my Next.js app using Clerk
evals.expectedBehavior: Should detect Next.js (next.config.*) and inform user that Clerk on Next.js is not in this plugin's wizard — should suggest using @clerk/nextjs directly with its own docs. Should alternatively offer to set up Better Auth or Firebase Auth via this plugin. Should NOT proceed with the Vite Clerk guide on a Next.js project.
